title: ConfigListOutput
description: The envelope `duckduckgo-search-cli config list` writes on stdout. It carries no `type` discriminator, so a consumer identifies it by the subcommand it invoked. Distinct from `config.schema.json`, which describes the CONTENT of the selector and user-agent files rather than the XDG key/value store this command reports. Added in v1.0.3 (GAP-SCHEMA-INTROSPECTION-UNDECLARED-001). English-only: these are configuration key names, which are part of the CLI contract and are never translated.

type.description: Envelope discriminator (v1.0.4+). Emitted by `types::ConfigKind::ConfigList`, a compiler-checked constant rather than a hand-typed literal.

allowed_keys.description: Every key `config set` accepts. This is the allowlist itself, not a sample: a key absent here is rejected, so an agent can validate a write before attempting it.

config_file.description: Absolute path of the XDG config file. Reported even when the file does not exist yet, so the caller learns where a `config set` would write.

values.description: Currently stored values, keyed by a member of `allowed_keys`. Absent keys are unset and fall back to the compiled default — an unset key is omitted rather than emitted as null, so presence alone means the operator chose it.

additionalProperties.description: TOML scalar as stored. Numeric knobs stay numeric; enum-like knobs are strings.
